points.description: Intermittent stream: flows during certain times of the year (seasonally), fed by groundwater; may be dry in dry periods (runoff is a supplementary source).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it flows part of the year without mentioning groundwater/dry periods, or only mentions groundwater.

points.description: Ephemeral stream: flows only during and briefly after precipitation events; not fed by groundwater (streambed above the water table).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it flows occasionally/after rain without the short-duration or no-groundwater idea.

rubric.notes: Award full marks for each stream type when its central idea is given in any wording: intermittent = seasonal flow supported by groundwater; ephemeral = flow only after rainfall, no groundwater. Give part marks for vague but correct-direction answers (e.g. "intermittent flows some of the year, ephemeral only after rain"). Give no marks for swapped or unrelated descriptions; extra remarks are ignored.
